title: Those are pretty thin
text: Those are pretty thin. We had 2 queen mattresses to move and the pack seemed like a good value, they both seemed pretty thin and one tore trying to get the  mattress into the bag. We patched it with duct tape, but I was hoping they would at least last from one place to another. Next time I'm going with 4 mil thickness.

product_metadata.title: [2-Pack 5-Mil] HOMEIDEAS Mattress Bag (Twin/Full) for Moving and Storage Opaque Mattress Disposal Bag - Heavy Duty & Tear Resistant
features: 5-mil Thick Bag: Made of LDPE, a recycled, reusable plastic material, our mattress bags are tear-resistant and durable, perfect for moving, long-term storage, renovation or disposal.
Specification: Each bag is 54 x 14 x 91 inch, two non-transparent bags included. open into real 3D shapes customized to fit your twin/full size mattress snugly.

Waterproof & Dustproof: No vent hole design. The extra long bag allows a double-overlap end flap which completely wraps up the whole mattress to keep out air, moisture and dust (Tape is not included).

Applicable Scene: HOMEIDEAS mattress bags are ideal for storing or transporting mattresses, but also useful for other bulky furniture like patio, chair, sofa, loveseat, even Christmas trees. Protects floor and furniture from oil paint when painting walls.
